editorial.last_message: Completed a self-contained Python GEDCOM/GEDZIP tool with schema data extracted from the supplied corpus; passes all212 corrected tests.
editorial.notes:
Astra completed voluntarily with41 self-tests and Python3.11 syntax checks. Source includes dedicated GEDCOM, GEDZIP, datatype and media modules plus bundled schema and a regeneration utility. The original4.0.1 grade was191/206. Its15 failures were seven tests incorrectly requiring xrefs and eight positive-family fixtures missing reciprocal links. The unchanged source passes212/212 under4.0.2, including six new focused reciprocal-link controls. No submission defect remains in this suite. Original source, transcript, session, grade and recorded usage are preserved; this regrade used no model inference and added no model cost. Token totals and reasoning/cache/tool counts were reparsed from the preserved telemetry. Docker egress and actual hosted-tool usage are audited separately; conditions are attached to the comparison cohort.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.
